ntm:machine_battery_socket.storage: No internal energy store. Slot0 must implement IBatteryItem; getPower/getMaxPower and rates delegate to that item. Empty or invalid slot returns zero.
ntm:machine_battery_socket.power_item_field: charge (source long NBT); pack getCharge initializes missing data to zero. charge/set/discharge setters do not clamp by themselves; callers apply limits.
ntm:machine_battery_socket.rates: provider = dischargeRate in output/buffer modes; receiver = chargeRate in input/buffer modes; otherwise zero.
ntm:machine_battery_socket.special_item_gap: Source battery_sc has fluctuation and discharge-beam behavior; battery_sc/cube_power/potato accessories are outside this batch.
ntm:machine_battery_socket.history: Average of previous and current power, compared to oldest of 20 samples; source uses long arithmetic.

ntm:machine_battery_redd.storage: Unbounded BigInteger energy, persisted as signed byte array. No invented fixed storage capacity.
ntm:machine_battery_redd.network_window_note: getMaxPower is Long.MAX_VALUE/100 for connection speed; getPower reports min(actual, network_window/2). setPower is a no-op; transferPower adds and returns0, usePower subtracts.
ntm:machine_battery_redd.tick_order: Base battery networking first; then charge from slot0 and charge item in slot1. Delta compares a BigInteger average against oldest of 20 samples.
ntm:machine_battery_redd.construction_gap: Original PlasmaForgeRecipes.java ass.fensusan; plasma forge not ported. No temporary crafting/assembly replacement.

battery_base.redstone: Any indirectly-powered port selects redHigh; otherwise redLow. Cached mode is reused by rate queries.
battery_base.network_membership: input=receiver only, output=provider only, buffer=both, none=neither. Invalid priority (null, ordinal0 or4) resets LOW.
battery_base.buttons: low/high advance modulo4; priority advances through LOW..HIGH and wraps.

distribution.supply: For valid providers: min(getPower(),getProviderSpeed()), include positive entries only.
distribution.demand: For valid receivers: min(getMaxPower()-getPower(),getReceiverSpeed()), include positive entries, grouped by priority.
distribution.delivery: Start toTransfer=min(totalSupply,totalDemand). Traverse priority groups from highest ordinal down; allocate trunc(clamp(toTransfer * demand_i/groupDemand,0,demand_i)); account for transferPower leftovers.
distribution.source_quirk: After EACH priority group the source subtracts cumulative energyUsed from toTransfer (not merely that group's delta). Preserve this literal behavior in a faithful port.
distribution.provider_debit: Proportional to each provider supply, Java double weight and long truncation. Remaining rounding surplus is debited from random providers, bounded by iterationsLeft.
distribution.tracker: Sum provider power before minus nonnegative provider power after; no synthetic cable loss or HE/t rating added.

network.link_validation: Same ConnectionType, distinct endpoints, Euclidean distance between connection points <= min(endpoint length limits). SINGLE/TRIPLE/QUAD describe compatibility, not a maximum link count.
network.connections: Persisted endpoint coordinate lists plus color. Medium pylons connect to adjacent devices only for transformer variants; connector uses its oriented back face; ordinary pylon excludes down.

switch.operation: Non-sneaking right click toggles metadata0/1. TileEntityCableSwitch joins only in state1 and destroys its node when switched off.

detector.operation: An input controlled by neighboring redstone: indirectly powered means metadata1, otherwise0. Uses the same switch tile. It does not measure energy throughput.

network.scope: Four cable identities are simple blocks without block entities. Connectors, pylons and controls reserve beehive/facing/honey state for future native logic; all are Inert now.

legacy_gaps.reason: Deprecated and creativeTab null; not imported as an active network device.

runtime_gaps: No native battery/network logic here. Item charge/tooltip and per-pack 3D renderer, wire placement, paint/disguise, gauge, cable boxes, collisions, full source orientations/multiblocks and menus remain separate work.
Four-way horizontal facing cannot encode every original six-face connector orientation; native geometry/orientation mapping remains to implement.
